1#_: (siman 100 seif 1) Beriah even in a thousand. Investigation of poskim; life-sustenance in summer; worms in food; nullification in minority; assembly of elders; Tosafot views on Sages nullifying Torah — end of his words.
2#_: (siman 100 seif 2) Cooked beriah with heter — recognition, gravy, gid hanasheh, fat, thigh, pieces, pot, melted gid — as Shulchan Aruch and Shach.
3#_: (siman 100 seif 3) Soup pot beriah lost — all forbidden.
4#_: (siman 100 seif 4) Three worms in vegetables — forbidden; strain water; rinse meat — chazakah three times.
